context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll module Phase 1 fully tested and working. Key verified calculations: Employee with base_salary=1200, 22 normal days → iliquido=1332€ (base + 132€ meal allowance), desconto_ss=132€ (11%), desconto_irs=60€ (5% bracket), liquido=1140€, custo_empresa=1617€ (includes 23.75% SS patronal). Overtime calculation verified: 2h OT per day splits into horas_extra_1 (first hour at 125%) and horas_extra_2 (remaining at 137.5%). All CRUD operations work for employees, attendance, and payroll runs. Close/reopen/delete run logic verified.
